summary: Full-stack testing of Velaryon V4 rebuild. Backend contact API (4 tests) passes 100%. Frontend flows all pass: loader -> navbar/hero, home sections, platform selector (VIPER/HAVOC/HUNTER switching with aria-selected, HAVOC video element with correct poster+src, VIPER/HUNTER image fallback), tech accordion, detail pages + redirects, navbar/footer nav, all page testids, mobile menu open/nav/close, contact form submit -> success + backend persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: PlatformSelector.tsx: PlatformMedia references window.matchMedia at render time — safe here (client component) but would break SSR. Fine for current Vite CSR setup.
server.py: GET /api/contact exposes all enquiries with no auth or pagination — acceptable per project note (demo/concept stage), but flag before production.
Loader blocks body scroll ~1.5s; ensure loader onDone always fires (setReady) even if animations are interrupted — currently OK.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-created enquiries in Mongo with TEST/pw_/pw2_/test_ email prefixes remain (small, ok).
context_for_next_testing_agent: tech accordion testids are zero-padded: tech-row-01..05 and tech-body-01..05 (NOT single-digit). Contact interest select is a native <select>; use page.select_option(..., label='Investment'). Havoc video renders when reduced-motion is not set — verify only element + poster + video URL 200 (H.264 playback not supported in headless Chromium per instructions). Backend uses EmailStr which rejects reserved TLDs like .test — use @example.com in tests.
